interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the vehicle access points to the minimum necessary, restoring the curb and sidewalk to provide a continuous, protected path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Delineated Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Use high-visibility markings or different paving materials to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way through the commercial apron.
